description.message: Shows what the site you are viewing can read about this browser. Nothing is sent or stored.

s_lead.message: Klin runs, inside the site you were viewing, the same checks a tracking script would run. Everything stays on your machine: nothing is sent, nothing is stored.

s_legend.message: **Protected**: the site gets nothing useful, or a value that is blurred or shared with many other users. **Exposed**: the site gets a value that helps to recognise you and that could be hidden. **Visible**: normal for any browser, but each value adds to your fingerprint.

s_foot.message: The test shows what is technically readable, not how rare your combination is: that would need comparing you with other users, which Klin does not do.

s_where_page.message: Tested as seen by this page.

s_where_tab.message: Tested as seen by {1}, in the tab you were viewing.

s_open.message: Open a website, then click the Klin self-test button in the toolbar.

s_cannot.message: This page cannot be tested (browser pages and a few protected sites do not allow it). Open an ordinary website and click the button again.

sv_canvas_random.message: random on every read: no usable identifier

sv_webrtc_placeholder.message: only a random placeholder name, no real address

sv_webrtc_none.message: no address handed to the page

sv_media_notsecure.message: not readable here: the page is not https

sv_media_named.message: {1} microphone(s), {2} camera(s), {3} speaker(s), with device names

st_global_privacy_control_why.message: Tells every site you refuse the sale and sharing of your data. Legally binding in some jurisdictions.

st_cookies_why.message: Sites you visit can store cookies; Klin keeps each site's cookies separate so they cannot follow you elsewhere. This test cannot check the separation itself.

st_local_network_address_webrtc_why.message: Video-call technology can reveal your address inside your home or office network, even behind a VPN.

st_connection_type_why.message: Wi-Fi, mobile or cable, and its speed.

st_browser_and_system_why.message: Announced to every site with each request.

st_processor_cores_why.message: A small number that differs between machines.

st_memory_size_why.message: Another hardware detail that narrows down your device.

st_battery_level_why.message: Charge level and charging time have been used to follow users across sites.

st_screen_and_window_why.message: Screen size is common; the exact window size is often unique.

st_touch_screen_why.message: Whether the device has a touch screen.

st_graphics_card_why.message: The model of your graphics hardware.

st_cameras_and_microphones_why.message: How many devices are connected; their names stay hidden until you grant access.

st_time_zone_why.message: Roughly where you are, even when your IP address is hidden.

st_canvas_drawing_why.message: A site draws an invisible picture and reads it back: tiny differences between machines make a stable identifier.

st_audio_processing_why.message: Same idea with an inaudible sound.

st_installed_fonts_why.message: The list of fonts on your machine is rarely the same as anyone else's.
